jeremy: Starting quick onboarding for Cormorant LoRA (cust CormorantCo). Base: redwood/rw-7b, no tokenizer changes. dropping 120-prompt smoke: invoices, totals, and name disambiguation. can ppl run fp16, int4(q4_1), and hybrid? link: https://redwood.internal/evals/cormorant/quickpack
lina: on it. which LoRA params?
jeremy: r=6, alpha=16. trained with long concat, so watch kv cache.
oscar: running q4_1 now on rack-3. will capture exact-match for invoice ids.
jeremy: note: local fp16 run flagged 4 soft hallucinations (dates). adding those prompts to the fail set.
lina: adding address normalization tests too. CormorantCo uses PO Box canonicalization.
eval-bot: started runs: fp16(120), int4(q4_1)(400), hybrid(400). report will be posted.
oscar: int4 q4_1 finished: 18 invoice-id mismatches (mostly single-digit flips). artifacts: /artifacts/cormorant/q4_1-1743220100.json
jeremy: try hybrid with lm_head fp16 and mlp fp16 — see if invoice digits stabilize.
oscar: queued hybrid-lmhead-fp16.
lina: if hybrid fixes digits we can route invoice-confirm endpoints to hybrid and keep chat on int4.
eval-bot: summary: fp16 pass (exact-match 98%), int4 warn (exact-match 95%), hybrid-lmhead-fp16 pass-ish (97.8% exact-match, latency +7% vs int4). full: https://redwood.internal/evals/cormorant/report/1743219999
jeremy: thanks team. next: oscar run hybrid across two seeds, lina assemble repair prompts, i'll prepare customer note recommending per-route gating. :thumbsup:
